title: Product
description: Schema for a VoltNest product record. Every entry in data/mock_data/products.json must conform to this schema. Used by the product lookup tool and validated at ingestion time.

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit. Unique identifier for this product. Format: 3-letter product code + year + color code (with hyphens).

name.description: Full product name as shown on the product page.

short_name.description: Friendly short name for natural language references. Used when the customer mentions the product by name (e.g., 'Where's my VoltBuds?').

category.description: Product category. Matches the categories used in the KB products folder.

subcategory.description: More specific classification within the category.

price_usd.description: Current retail price in USD. Must match the price in the KB product page.

compare_at_price_usd.description: Original price before a sale. Null if the product is not on sale. Must be higher than price_usd when present.

currency.description: Currency code for pricing. VoltNest always uses USD.

description.description: Short product description (1–2 sentences) as shown on the product page.

color.description: Default/main color variant for this SKU.

available_colors.description: All color variants available for this product family.

in_stock.description: Whether this product is currently available for purchase.

stock_quantity.description: Current inventory count at the Memphis distribution center. When in_stock is false, this should be 0.

weight_grams.description: Shipping weight in grams, including packaging.

shipping.description: Shipping characteristics and restrictions. Determines which destinations the product can ship to.

domestic_eligible.description: Whether this product can ship within the United States.

international_eligible.description: Whether this product can ship outside the United States. False for products with lithium batteries that exceed carrier limits.

lithium_battery.description: Whether this product contains a lithium-ion battery. Affects shipping and airline rules.

battery_wh.description: Total battery capacity in Watt-hours. Zero for products without batteries.

restricted_regions.description: Regions where this product cannot ship. Empty if no restrictions beyond international_eligible.

restriction_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the product is restricted, if any. Required when restricted_regions is non-empty.

warranty_months.description: Length of the manufacturer's warranty in months. VoltNest standard is 12 months.

return_window_days.description: Number of days the customer can return this product. VoltNest standard is 30 days from delivery.

rating.description: Average customer rating (0–5) rounded to one decimal.

tags.description: Controlled vocabulary tags from data/taxonomy/tags.yaml. Used for retrieval filtering.

related_skus.description: Other product SKUs commonly purchased with this product or referenced in its KB page. Enables cross-sell and product graph.

launch_date.description: Date the product was first available for purchase. ISO 8601 date format.

last_updated.description: Date the product record was last updated. ISO 8601 date format.

allOf.description: Sale price must be lower than the original compare_at_price

price_usd.description: Sale price must be strictly less than compare_at_price

allOf.description: Stock quantity must be 0 when in_stock is false
restriction_reason required when restricted_regions is non-empty
Products with lithium batteries must declare battery_wh > 0

examples.name: VoltBuds Pro Wireless Earbuds
examples.description: True-wireless earbuds with 8-hour battery, Bluetooth 5.3, and IPX5 water resistance. Dual-mic ENC for calls. Multipoint pairing with 2 devices.

examples.name: VoltBank 20K Power Bank
examples.description: 20,000 mAh power bank with 65W laptop-capable output and digital LED display. Recharges in 2 hours via 65W USB-C.

shipping.restriction_reason: Lithium battery exceeds international air transport limits for retail shipments
